name: Claude
description: Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant, used to write, analyse, work through problems and handle longer documents, with separate plans for individuals, teams and enterprises.
features: Chat on web, desktop and mobile
Web search, file creation and code execution
Projects (up to 5 on the free plan)
Claude Code included with Team plans
strengths: Free plan includes web search, file creation and memory
Team and Enterprise plans add central billing, SSO and admin controls
limitations: Usage limits apply on every plan and reset on a rolling five-hour window; paid plans add weekly limits
The pricing page gives no fixed message count

plans.name: Free
highlights: Chat on web, desktop and mobile

plans.name: Max
plans.note: Shown as 'from $100 per month'; no separate annual price on the page

plans.name: Team (Premium seat)
highlights: 5x the usage of a Standard seat

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.billing: Billed annually, 20-seat minimum, plus usage at API rates
highlights: Compliance API, custom data retention, IP allowlisting

free.details: Free for everyone: chat on web, desktop and mobile, web search, file creation and code execution, memory, connectors, Artifacts, up to 5 projects. Usage limits apply.

api.summary: API usage is billed per million tokens (input/output): Fable 5.1 $10/$50, Opus 5.5 $4/$20, Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10, Haiku 5.5 $0.10/$0.50 for prompts up to 100K tokens. Batch processing is stated as a 50% saving; web search is $10 per 1,000 searches; code execution includes 50 free hours per day per organisation, then $0.05 per hour per container.

pricing.regional: Displayed prices do not include applicable tax. US-only inference is available at 1.1x token pricing. Other regional pricing: not stated.

verification.notes: Product active. Individual tab: Free $0; Pro $17/month on annual billing ($200 billed up front) or $20 billed monthly; Max from $100/month (5x and 20x tiers), monthly billing only. Team & Enterprise tab: Standard seat $20 annual / $25 monthly; Premium seat $100 annual / $125 monthly; Enterprise US$20 per seat per month billed annually, 20 seat minimum, plus usage at API rates. Prices exclude tax.

profile.headline: An AI assistant you hand tasks to, not just questions

capabilities.title: Hand it a task, not just a question
capabilities.text: Claude can mine data, pull information together and make a first draft for you to review.

capabilities.title: Turn ideas into finished work
capabilities.text: It can produce decks, working prototypes, financial models and editable drafts.

capabilities.title: Work with the files you already have
capabilities.text: It works with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDFs, CSVs and more.

capabilities.title: Build visuals
capabilities.text: It creates charts, diagrams, interactive visuals, artifacts and designs.

featureCards.name: Connectors to your apps
featureCards.text: Link Claude to tools such as Slack, Gmail, Google Calendar, Salesforce, Amplitude, BigQuery and Gong so it can work with the information that lives there.

featureCards.name: Memory, projects and saved instructions
featureCards.text: Context carries across conversations, so you do not have to explain the same background each time.

featureCards.name: Edits you can review
featureCards.text: Changes show up as tracked changes or highlighted cells, and Claude can ask before it acts.

featureCards.name: Tasks that keep running
featureCards.text: Hand work off from your phone and Claude keeps going in the cloud; tasks can run on a schedule or in parallel.

featureCards.name: Skills, plugins and custom connectors
featureCards.text: Add capabilities with skills, plugins and your own connectors or MCP servers.

featureCards.name: Permissions and admin controls
featureCards.text: Team and Enterprise plans add access controls and admin tools.

audienceDetail.text: Campaign readouts and social asset sets.
Budget reforecasts, month-end close and earnings comparisons.
Merit analysis and job description checks.
Contract redlines, legal research and deposition preparation.
Meeting action tracking, feedback digests and metrics dashboards.

scenarios.title: Prepare for a sales call
scenarios.text: Pull together what you know about the account and update the CRM afterwards.

scenarios.title: Close the month
scenarios.text: Work through a month-end close or an H2 budget reforecast and review the result as tracked changes.

scenarios.title: Review a contract
scenarios.text: Get contract redlines and background legal research as a first pass for a person to check.

scenarios.title: Digest customer feedback
scenarios.text: Turn a pile of feedback into a digest and a metrics dashboard.

gettingStarted.text: Go to claude.ai, or download the web, desktop or mobile apps.
Say what you want in plain language and point Claude to the files and tools it should use.
Add the apps you already use from the Connectors page.
Browse the use cases on the product page, or ask Claude where to start.
